name: Crypto
author: Thales Augusto
description: Bitcoin and favorite crypto prices in the Omarchy bar — coin logos, 24h change, 7-day sparkline, market stats.

barWidget.description: Price pill for one favorite coin, plus a popup listing every favorite with 24h change and a 7-day sparkline. Prices and logos from CoinGecko.

schema.label: Favorite coins
schema.description: CoinGecko coin ids, comma-separated, in display order. Find an id in the URL of a coin page on coingecko.com (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana, dogecoin). Empty means bitcoin.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: CoinGecko's free API allows roughly 30 calls per minute across the whole machine. Keep this at 60 or more.

schema.label: Rotate every (seconds)
schema.description: Walk the bar through every favorite on a timer. 0 keeps the pinned coin in place. Rotation holds while the popup is open or the pointer is on the pill.

schema.label: Show ticker symbol
schema.description: Show BTC, ETH, ... before the price.

schema.label: Show 24h change
schema.description: Append the 24 hour percentage change to the bar label.

schema.label: Compact price
schema.description: Abbreviate large prices, e.g. $67.4k instead of $67,432.

schema.label: Colorize the bar label
schema.description: Tint the label with the theme accent when up and the urgent color when down.
